entries.text: 为什么会输！\n为什么，为什么！为什么啊～！！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_00

entries.text: １年零几个月前……
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_system_01

entries.text: 那个仿造车完全动不了啊。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_01

entries.text: 是天星队车！！\n不叫仿造车！\r\n那可是我通宵造出来的！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_02

entries.text: 动力明显不够啊。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_01

entries.text: 天星队车实在是太重了，\n想要靠２只炭小侍推动它是不可能的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_02

entries.text: 本来如果能让它动起来的话，\n那些爱霸凌人的学生一定会吓呆的……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_kakutouboss_01

entries.text: 对不起……不该是这样的……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_03

entries.text: 竟然能以手工造出如此杰作，\n奥尔迪加大人实乃天才……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_dokuboss_02

entries.text: ……动不了还有什么意义？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_04

entries.text: 早知如此的话，\n拜托妈妈帮我买车就好了……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_05

entries.text: 你就是因为总说这种话\n才会被瞧不起。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_02

entries.text: 梅洛可，你快别说了。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_03

entries.text: 我就要说。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_03

entries.text: 成立天星队时指定的规矩里，\n不是有不再依靠家长或钱的这一条吗？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_04

entries.text: 动不了的话，让它动起来不就行了？\n动力不够的话，增加动力不就行了？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_05

entries.text: 可是，要怎么做才好？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_kakutouboss_02

entries.text: 培育炭小侍，让它进化。\n再把它的火力用在天星队车上。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_06

entries.text: 天星大作战迫在眉睫……\n赶得上吗？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_dokuboss_03

entries.text: 赶不上也要赶上！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_07

entries.text: 梅洛可也是，不管嘴上怎么说，\n骨子里倒是没有恶意啊。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_04

entries.text: 可恶！我明明输得这么不甘心，\n却也有认可你的心情！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_11

entries.text: 只要输了就不能当老大了……\n毕竟不遵守规矩\r\n就等于背叛天星队啊。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_12

entries.text: 没办法，拿去吧。\n你应该感到荣幸！！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_13

entries.text: 别想这么容易就离开……\n你还得收下我中意的这个东西。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_waza_01

entries.text: 我先说清楚了，\n你可是让我相当、相当不爽！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_14

entries.text: 不过，我也承认你的实力很强！\n你都把我的天星队车给毁了！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_15

entries.text: ……奥尔迪加少爷。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_01

entries.text: 到练钢琴的时间了啊。\n你是来接我的吧。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_17

entries.text: 正好我刚刚下台不当老大了。\n差不多也该回家了……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_18

entries.text: ……不，\n我想向少爷介绍一个人。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_19

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_20

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_04

entries.text: ……他和我有一点点交情。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_05

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_21

entries.text: [EMPTY 85]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_06

entries.text: 叫我聂凯吧。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_01

entries.text: 哦……你的目的是什么？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_22

entries.text: 你是服装公司的公子……\n有这样的背景，为何还要加入天星队？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_02

entries.text: 一上来就问人问题，真没礼貌。\n理由和其他队员一样。\r\n因为我也一直被人霸凌……[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_23

entries.text: 看来学院里\n果然有霸凌行为啊……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_03

entries.text: 你不知道也很正常。\n毕竟现在整个学校都很太平。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_24

entries.text: 而且那些爱霸凌人的学生\n都已经退学了。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_25

entries.text: ……这是怎么回事？[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_04

entries.text: ……关于这一点，就由我这个\n上一任校长来说明吧。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_07

entries.text: 大约在１年半之前，\n天星队和霸凌他们的学生之间\r\n发生了一场骚动。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_08

entries.text: 虽然事情没有闹到不可收拾，\n但也是一件前所未闻的大事件。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_09

entries.text: 这件事导致的结果是\n身为霸凌的加害者的学生们\r\n在那之后退学了。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_10

entries.text: 可是学院里没有那样的记录……！[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_05

entries.text: 想必也是没有吧……\n因为记录被当时的\r\n教导主任删掉了……[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_11

entries.text: 删掉了记录！？\n天啊，居然会发生这种事……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_06

entries.text: 在我正愁于如何处置天星队的时候，\n有个学生出现在了我的面前。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_12

entries.text: 那个学生说\n自己会为天星队负全责。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_13

entries.text: 作为交换条件，那个学生\n请求我免除对伙伴们的处分。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_14

entries.text: 咦！？这种事……！\n根本没听说过啊……！！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_27

entries.text: 我接受了那个学生的请求，\n打消了处分天星队的念头。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_15

entries.text: 然后，我要求那个学生\n进行为期１年半的留学。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_16

entries.text: ……用来代替处分。\n天星队是霸凌行为的受害者。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_17

entries.text: 我希望让那个学生的心灵\n得到休息，于是以留学的名义\r\n让他回到了他的老家伽勒尔地区。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_18

entries.text:
就在那时，当时的教导主任
为了逃避自己的责任，\c
把和事件相关的记录
都从服务器上删掉了……[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_19

entries.text: 岂有此理！\n他居然隐瞒了真相吗……！[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_08

entries.text: 当然，我对教导主任\n做出了应有的处分。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_20

entries.text: 但是，没能制止\n这种行为的我以及\r\n其他老师也有同样的责任……[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_21

entries.text:
于是为了承担责任，
我辞去了校长一职。\c
也请当时所有的老师
也一起辞职了。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_24

entries.text: 所以１年半前\n老师们才会大换血啊……[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_09

entries.text: 我给大家添麻烦了啊。[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_22

entries.text: 老管家，\n为什么你现在会说这个？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_28

entries.text: ……不管是少爷还是天星队，\n再这样下去可不行。\r\n我希望这能成为一个契机……[VAR 0x0114(003C)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_23

entries.text: 事到如今，背叛伙伴自己一个人\n去学校这种事是无法想象的。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_29

entries.text: 看来你真的很重视\n天星队的各位啊。[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_10

entries.text: 毕竟他们……都是我的宝物啊。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_31
